name: Marco Rubio
summary: U.S. Secretary of State and former U.S. senator with a documented public record of calling for serious investigation of UAP reported near military installations and discussing the issue during his Senate tenure.

relationships.context: Rubio has made public statements supporting serious investigation of UAP and discussing transparency and alleged concealment.
Rubio has discussed UAP in the context of military installations, airspace, classified information and national-security oversight.
